title.value: Learnable Filters for Geometric Scattering Modules
title.justification: The paper introduces a new graph neural network module called LEGS (learnable geometric scattering module), which is a central concept throughout the paper.
title.quote: "We propose a new graph neural network (GNN) module, based on relaxations of recently proposed geometric scattering transforms, which consist of a cascade of graph wavelet filters."

extractions.description: The paper introduces the LEGS module, a learnable geometric scattering module for graph neural networks, enabling adaptive tuning of wavelets. It outperforms traditional GNNs and pure geometric scattering on various datasets, especially in biochemical domains. The paper also emphasizes its robustness, efficiency, and the ability to capture long-range dependencies in graph data.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on graph neural networks and geometric scattering, without direct relevance to identified eco-responsible AI applications.
primary_category.quote: "Our learnable geometric scattering (LEGS) module enables adaptive tuning of the wavelets to encourage band-pass features to emerge in learned representations."

secondary_categories.justification: The paper is centered around improvements in graph neural networks without direct applications to eco-responsible AI categories.
secondary_categories.quote: "We demonstrate the predictive performance of LEGS-based networks on graph classification benchmarks, as well as the descriptive quality of their learned features in biochemical graph data exploration tasks."

primary_sub_category.justification: This research does not directly focus on eco-responsible applications as outlined in the provided categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: "Our results show that LEGS-based networks match or outperforms popular GNNs, as well as the original geometric scattering construction, on many datasets, in particular in biochemical domains."

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Like the primary category, the advancements in graph neural networks are not applied to eco-responsible fields in this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: "we find that our network maintains performance in social network and other node classification tasks where state-of-the-art GNNs perform well."

new_primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on enhancing the capabilities of graph neural networks using learnable geometric scattering modules.
new_primary_category.quote: "We introduce the geometric scattering module, which can be used within a larger neural network. We call this a learnable geometric scattering (LEGS) module."

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category precisely captures the essence of the paper, which is developing a learnable extension of geometric scattering transforms for graph neural networks.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: "The geometric scattering transform can represent nodes or graphs based on multi-scale diffusions, and differences between scales of diffusions of graph signals (i.e., node features)."
